title: Defense skips cross examination of PNP official over VP's firearms

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense panel in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte has forgone cross-examining a Philippine National Police Firearms and Explosives Office (PNP-FEO) official after it was established that the supposed price of Duterte’s firearms was market value, not acquisition cost. During the resumption of the trial on Monday, Duterte’s lawyer Carlo Joaquin Narvasa said they will no longer cross examine P/Maj. Joericson Sangalang, head of the PNP-FEO, since impeachment court Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero established through his questioning that the prices presented were merely market values as of the current year.
